Load wehoop WNBA Stats box scores

Source: R/load_wnba_stats_extra.R
load_wnba_stats_player_boxscores.Rd

load_wnba_stats_player_boxscores() loads WNBA Stats API (boxscoretraditionalv3) player box scores, one row per player per game, from the wnba_stats_player_boxscores release tag. load_wnba_stats_team_boxscores() loads the matching team totals, one row per team per game, from the wnba_stats_team_boxscores release tag. Both carry the WNBA Stats ids (team_id, person_id, game_id), not ESPN's; for ESPN box scores see load_wnba_player_box() and load_wnba_team_box().

Usage

load_wnba_stats_player_boxscores(
  seasons = most_recent_wnba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

load_wnba_stats_team_boxscores(
  seasons = most_recent_wnba_stats_season(),
  ...,
  dbConnection = NULL,
  tablename = NULL
)

Source

https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/wnba_stats_player_boxscores, https://github.com/sportsdataverse/sportsdataverse-data/releases/tag/wnba_stats_team_boxscores

Arguments

seasons

A vector of 4-digit years associated with given WNBA seasons. Both releases start in 2026, so coverage runs 2026 through the most recent season. Pass seasons = TRUE for every published season. (Min: 2026)

...

Additional arguments passed to an underlying function that writes the season data into a database.

dbConnection

A DBIConnection object, as returned by DBI::dbConnect()

tablename

The name of the box score data table within the database

Value

load_wnba_stats_player_boxscores() returns a wehoop_data tibble with one row per player per game:

col_nametypesdescription
team_idintegerWNBA Stats team identifier.
team_namecharacterTeam nickname (e.g. 'Liberty').
team_tricodecharacterThree-letter team code (e.g. 'NYL').
sidecharacterhome or away.
person_idintegerWNBA Stats player identifier.
first_namecharacterPlayer first name.
family_namecharacterPlayer last name.
name_icharacterAbbreviated name (e.g. 'B. Stewart').
player_slugcharacterURL slug of the player.
positioncharacterStarting position (blank for reserves).
commentcharacterDid-not-play reason, if any.
jersey_numcharacterJersey number.
minutescharacterMinutes played (MM:SS).
field_goals_madeintegerField goals made.
field_goals_attemptedintegerField goals attempted.
field_goals_percentagenumericField goal percentage (0-1).
three_pointers_madeintegerThree-pointers made.
three_pointers_attemptedintegerThree-pointers attempted.
three_pointers_percentagenumericThree-point percentage (0-1).
free_throws_madeintegerFree throws made.
free_throws_attemptedintegerFree throws attempted.
free_throws_percentagenumericFree throw percentage (0-1).
rebounds_offensiveintegerOffensive rebounds.
rebounds_defensiveintegerDefensive rebounds.
rebounds_totalintegerTotal rebounds.
assistsintegerAssists.
stealsintegerSteals.
blocksintegerBlocks.
turnoversintegerTurnovers.
fouls_personalintegerPersonal fouls.
pointsintegerPoints.
plus_minus_pointsnumericPlus/minus while on court.
game_idcharacterUnique game identifier (10-digit, zero-padded).
seasonintegerSeason identifier (4-digit year).

load_wnba_stats_team_boxscores() returns a wehoop_data tibble with one row per team per game: team_id, team_name, team_tricode, side, minutes, the same shooting, rebounding and counting columns from field_goals_made through plus_minus_points, game_id and season.

See also

Other WNBA Stats loader functions: load_wnba_stats_game_lineups(), load_wnba_stats_leaguedash(), load_wnba_stats_metric_curves(), load_wnba_stats_rolling_windows(), load_wnba_stats_rosters()
